note: The nurse's lines during a wristband mismatch or a missing band (p0-voice-audio-s06, DT-008). Written by the developer: procedural only, no clinical fact and nothing patient-specific (that comes from the Core state), each awaiting review. The trigger is the engine's nurse step (WristbandResolution) or the action outcome that plays the line; subtitles show exactly this text.

lines.text: Thanks for telling me. Let me check.
Excuse me, I'm just coming in to the bedside.
I'm checking the band against the patient's records now.
The details on the band did not match the records, so I'm replacing it with a correct one.
There's no band on, so I'm putting one on now.
The new band is on. Please read it again before you go on.
Of course, I'll bring a band and put it on.
Before I put a band on, please confirm who the patient is.
I've put an allergy band on as well, for the allergy the patient has told us about.
The band is on and it matches. There's nothing to change.
